Topic 4.1: Sewing skills: Constructing household items
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sewing skills: Constructing household items, part of PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Lea in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can a household item be made using seams? 2. Why is identifying types of seams crucial in clothing construction?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sewing skills: Constructing household items together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Integrity: The learners prudently utilise materials to construct a household item using seams.

● Responsibility: The learners take care of the materials used during construction of household items.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Safety and security: The learners observe safety for self and others as they use sharp tools for constructing household items using

seams.

Link to other subjects:

● Learners relate construction of household items using seams to artistic skills (pattern work) learnt in Creative Arts and Sports.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Samples of made seams

● Samples of knitwear

● Various clothing and household items made using different seams

● Fabrics/material

● Machine sewing threads

● Signs Language Dictionary
